what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Pakistan in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 23901 Pakistani asylum seekers in Italy, 36.7% of all asylum seekers from Pakistan.
Refugees from Pakistan, a separate group, live mostly in Afghanistan, the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan from 2007 to 2025, at war level in some years, with the TTP, Lashkar-e-Islam and IMU among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2006, most recently with the BRAS from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 436 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 24466, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
